# Ninewood — Copilot / chat assistants

- Always follow root `AGENTS.md` first.
- Package manager is **pnpm**, not npm workspaces.
- Windows desktop only: no mobile breakpoints, touch handlers, or PWA.
- **Do not read or cite `archive/**`, `docs/archive/**`, `.workbuddy/memory/**`, `.agents/**`, or `.reasonix/**`** unless the human explicitly asks for historical archaeology. These are historical or duplicated tool context.
- Do not read local `.env` files, `server/uploads/**`, `_tmp/**`, or `DEPLOY.md`; they are secrets, user data, or generated output.
- Living docs: `docs/README.md`, `docs/DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md`, `docs/ENGINEERING_OVERVIEW.md`, `docs/回的理念.md`, `docs/specs/NATURAL-LOOP-V2-ADR.md`, `docs/specs/DEMAND-SERVICE-CARD-ADR.md`, `docs/specs/AGENT-*.md`.
